primaryHypothesis.designContribution: Progressive protection failure should turn abstract objective health into a visible causal rally point.
primaryHypothesis.intendedPlayerBehavior: Players notice the exposed sector, prioritize a defensible response, and later connect objective failure to a preparation decision.
primaryHypothesis.recognitionTest: At mobile far distance, a player identifies the objective, its front access and its current integrity without UI or color-only cues.
primaryHypothesis.decisionMetric: A non-briefed player names the failed protection sector and chooses a coherent protect, repair or reposition response without being told a solution.
primaryHypothesis.failureCondition: The core resembles a weapon, health depends on glow alone, damage appears arbitrary, or the critical state looks already defeated.
